channel.name: ABC News 24 AU
channel.title: ABC News Mornings
channel.desc: Stay in the know with what's happening this morning. ABC News brings you up-to-the-minute news to fuel your daily conversations so you can stay connected and follow the discussion across the day. Presented by Gemma Veness.

channel.name: ABC News 24 AU
channel.title: ABC News At Noon
channel.desc: The leading news at lunchtime. Ros Childs brings you the day's top stories and the latest news as it unfolds, with reporters in the community across Australia and around the world reporting on the issues that matter to you.

channel.name: ABC News 24 AU
channel.title: ABC News Day
channel.desc: The home of breaking news, rolling coverage and live updates on the day's top stories. Stay in the know throughout the afternoon as Ros Childs brings you the latest news and analysis from reporters and guests.

channel.name: ABC News 24 AU
channel.title: ABC News Afternoons
channel.desc: More news, more often. Wherever you are stay in touch with ABC News through the day. We have reporters in more places, to tell you what's happening and why it matters. Ros Childs brings you the latest news and information.

channel.name: ABC News 24 AU
channel.title: Afternoon Briefing
channel.desc: Your daily download of everything you need to know about politics, national and global affairs. Patricia Karvelas asks politicians the tough questions and talks to key players and experts on the issues driving the news cycle.

channel.title: ABC News With Joe O'Brien
channel.desc: Lorna Dunkley brings you a comprehensive summary of the day's events, with the latest breaking news, in depth coverage of the top stories, live crosses, interviews and explainers to bring you up to speed on what's going on.

channel.name: ABC News 24 AU
channel.title: ABC News Hour
channel.desc: Lorna Dunkley presents the day's top stories and the latest news. From your neighbourhood, across Australia and around the globe, ABC News has reporters following the stories that matter so you can stay in the know.

channel.name: ABC News 24 AU
channel.title: ABC National News
channel.desc: There's never been a more important time for transparency and trust. ABC News brings you the day's top stories and latest news, with more reporters to tell you what's going on and why it matters. Presented by Lorna Dunkley.

channel.name: ABC News 24 AU
channel.desc: Sarah Ferguson presents Australia's premier daily current affairs program, delivering agenda-setting public affairs journalism and interviews that hold the powerful to account. Plus political analysis from Jacob Greber.

channel.name: ABC News 24 AU
channel.title: ABC News Tonight
channel.desc: The latest breaking news and a comprehensive roundup of the day's best stories from across Australia's states and regions. With reporters in more places ABC News tells the stories that matter to you. Presented by Yvonne Yong.[(96057)]
